summary: Non-modal floating panel anchored to a trigger, with interactive content.
whenNotToUse: Only a text description: use Tooltip.
Content that requires exclusive attention: use Dialog.

props.name: title
props.description: Visible heading, also used as the accessible name.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when there is no title.

props.name: placement
props.description: Preferred placement; flips when there is not enough space.

inherits: Props of the react-aria-components Popover. PopoverSurface is the surface reused by Select, Combobox, Menu and DatePicker.

keyboard.action: On the trigger, opens the popover and moves focus inside.
Closes and returns focus to the trigger.

accessibility: Non-modal dialog semantics with a required accessible name (title or aria-label).
Rendered in the nearest ThemeProvider portal.
responsive: Repositions and limits its height to stay within the viewport.
customization: className/style; surface, radius and elevation tokens.
commonMistakes: Opening popovers on hover only: the content must also be reachable via keyboard and touch.

examples.title: Controlled with an edit form
examples.description: isOpen + onOpenChange on PopoverTrigger: Salva updates the name and closes, Annulla closes without changes.

examples.name: WithoutTitle
examples.title: Without title, without arrow and with long text
examples.description: Accessible name from aria-label; long content wraps within a maximum width.
